speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I want the whole drift loop to run without a human touching it, not just the first leg. If you stop at the hand-over, we are still waiting on a person to notice the alert.
output.correction: You filed this as a request for better dashboards, but I am talking about removing the manual step entirely. The system must detect, alert, and trigger the response on its own.
